_meta.pocket: West-downtown Toronto corridor: Queen West, Ossington, Dundas West, Kensington/Chinatown, Little Italy, King West/Liberty Village, Parkdale, Roncesvalles, The Junction
_meta.provenance: Compiled 2026-11-05 from each shop's own website or public booking platform profile (Fresha, Booksy, Dash Booking, Square Appointments, Setmore). The sandbox for this pass blocked direct fetches of booking platforms and of the shops' own sites (proxy CONNECT 403 / unresolvable hosts), so all sourcing and verification are search-derived (extended web search snapshots of the platforms' and shops' own pages); per-listing notes say which source each menu came from and which durations are estimates. Nail shops skew Fresha-heavy, but several in this pocket actually book on Dash Booking or Square Appointments, with only an unclaimed call-to-book Fresha stub; the live booking platform was preferred in each case. priceTier derives from the classic manicure price (<=$35 tier 2, $36-55 tier 3, >$55 tier 4); where no classic manicure is published, the gel manicure price minus ~$10 was used as a proxy and the notes say so. Only shops where nails are the core offering are listed; full-service spas and hair salons that merely offer manicures were excluded. No ratings are included because we have no authorized rating source. The sync script verifies every bookingUrl responds before a listing goes live and drops entries whose URL fails.
_meta.exclusions: Excluded on purpose, with reasons, as of 2026-11-05. Closed or possibly closed: Ivy Nails (2957 Dundas W; Yelp marked closed May 2026, Fresha lvp page is stale), Rainbow Nail & Spa (222 Spadina; a Yelp snapshot shows Closed, two conflicting phone numbers, and directories give the address to Rainbow Skin Care Spa). No shop-published price or confirmed booking page: Pretty Star Nails Spa (171 Roncesvalles; Fresha snapshots mix other salons' menus into its page), The Ten Spot Roncesvalles (117 Roncesvalles; only a 2013 blog price, and a multi-service beauty-bar chain), Glamour Nails (2239 Dundas W; Fresha lists services only), Hollywood Nails (2214 Dundas W; a Fresha area-page price could not be attributed; hours and postal code conflict), Lucy Nails (3065 Dundas W; only a 2017 review), High Park Nail Bar (3114 Dundas W; call to book, no prices), DY Nail Studio (149 Augusta; no attributable prices), Healthy Nails (222 Spadina #136), Top Coat Nail Salon (1450 Queen W; no booking URL, three conflicting phones), Pink Nail Bar (123 Ossington; Fresha lvp is call-to-book and its own site's shellac prices conflict $40 vs $55 - relist once its booking page is pinned down), Project Essence (219 Ossington; prices only on a third-party aggregator, mixed nails/brows/lashes), Emi's nails salon (859 Dundas W; Fresha lvp lists services only), Naked Beauty Bar (889 Dundas W; call-to-book lvp, prices only on third-party Beautster, conflicting hours suggest staleness), THEGRACE Nail Art (660 Queen W; call-to-book stub), MS23 Nails Beauty Care (680 Queen W; cryptic Fresha menu items, business name varies between sources), Nails On Queen (606 Queen W; booksalon.ca snippet jumbles prices and services, unclaimed Fresha stub), RE:SET Nail Spa (68 Abell St #9; no full price list, only a ClassPass add-on), Tips & Toes Nail Spa (171 East Liberty; only third-party guide estimates), Cures Studio (171 E Liberty Unit 141; no prices, Yelp files it under skin care so possibly not nail-core), 550 Nail Bar (550 Front W; call-to-book stub, also edge of pocket), Sixth Sense Spa & Nail Lounge (901 King W; ambiguous lvp prices, own site shows no prices for this branch). Price conflicts too risky to list: Queen Nails & Spa (1388 Queen W, Parkdale; two different menus attributed to the address in 1.5-2 year old snapshots, lvp shows no prices), Nail Art Bar (1176 Queen W; its own site and Fresha conflict), Hue Atelier (2005 Dundas W; its spa-menu snapshots came through garbled, classic mani 'from $30' vs 'from $40' - the strongest bench candidate, re-check when its site can be fetched directly). Address or identity conflicts: Fix NailBar (Fresha slug says Keele St but the page shows 100 Ossington Ave Ste 08; its Zenoti prices cannot be tied to a branch), Kuko House (889 vs 1273 Dundas W, the latter being Emily House's address; prices only on Beautster), King West Nails Spa / King Nails & Beauty / L And A Nails (932 King W; four names and three phones at one address, conflicting prices), Tips and Tonic Nail Studio (833 vs 393 King W, Fresha slug references Dundas; call-to-book stub), Organic Nail Bar Queen West (496 vs 438 Queen W with swapped phones across sources - the chain's King West branch is listed instead), AR Studios (2988 Dundas W unconfirmed; appears only as a 'venue nearby' on other Fresha pages). Spas or salons, not nail-core: Blade Beauty Boutique (1650 Queen W; laser/skin/injectables, placeholder 'from $1' Fresha prices and a conflicting second address), GIOIA Beauty Bar & Spa (20 Joe Shuster Way; day spa), Majesty's Pleasure (556 King W; full-service spa). Out of the coverage pocket: Sarang Nails (633A Bloor W; a Fresha category page wrongly shows it at 166 Ossington, which is SOLiS-tokyo's address), Vanity Nail & Beauty Bar (2358 Bloor W), Kuo Qi Nails (2875 Bloor W), Supreme Nail Spa (823 Lansdowne), LeLuxe Nail Studio (1033 Bay; also has duplicate Fresha profiles), Everest Nail Salon (250 Dundas W), GLO Nails Studio (275 Dundas W), Nails For You (109 Dundas W), Cozy nails & spa (386 College), Essential Beauty Bar (225 Queen W), Polish'd Nail Bar (130 King W), Nails Touch (317 King W), Pearl Nail Bar Dundas East (96 Dundas E), Loft Nail Studio (250 Queen W near University; its Roncesvalles branch at 389 Roncesvalles has prices only on third-party Beautster). Unresearched in-pocket lead for the next pass: Yellow Mellow Clawz (1084 Queen W; dismissed as out-of-area during research but actually inside the Ossington radius - nothing verified yet).

listings.name: Sekai Nail and Beauty Bar
listings.notes: Added 2026-11-05 (search-derived) from the shop's own women's-services page, which agrees with its Fresha profile. Durations are Fresha-published; gel mani shows 45min-1h and gel pedi 1h-1h15, lower bounds used. Gel removal is a $5 add-on; the shop does not do acrylic/extension removals. A $105 Gel-X item on some Fresha entries is not on the site menu and was left out. Books on Fresha. Queen West at the Trinity Bellwoods end.

listings.name: Jaysee Nails
listings.notes: Added 2026-11-05 (search-derived) from the shop's claimed Fresha profile. Gel-X durations published (1h); builder gel published as 1-2h, lower bound used; removal duration estimated. Russian-manicure and Gel-X specialist; no classic/gel manicure price published, so priceTier 4 is a proxy from the $90 builder gel. Fresha aggregator pages ~700 days old show an 1142 Davenport Rd address; the live profile says 890 Queen W, so Davenport is treated as a former address - spot-check. Queen West.

listings.name: Pearl Nail Bar (Queen West)
listings.notes: Added 2026-11-05 (search-derived): prices from the chain's own site services page (marked 'Queen location only') and the Fresha profile, which agree. Shellac mani and classic pedi durations are Fresha-published; the other two estimated. A second Fresha slug exists for this venue with a different service count; the one matching the chain's naming pattern is used. Shellac pedicure snapshots ranged $50-75; the own-site $50 figure is used. Fresha calls it 'Pearl Nail Bar & Head Spa on Queen' - head spa is an add-on, nails are the core menu. One of four Pearl Nail Bar locations (two others listed; Dundas E branch is out of pocket). Queen West across from Trinity Bellwoods Park.

listings.address: 1205 Queen St W, Unit 6, Toronto, ON
listings.notes: Added 2026-11-05 (search-derived) from the shop's own site's hand-and-foot-care menu; durations estimated. The shop's Fresha lvp profile confirms the address but is call-to-book with no online booking, so the shop's own site is the booking link (booking is effectively by phone - same handling as barber listings whose sites carry the menu).
